roleInfo.species: Species role: every Pokémon of its species shares it. It sums up what the species is best at (usually its highest base stat) and has no effect of its own.

roleInfo.natureTip: The nature belongs to this Pokémon, not to its species: it raises one stat by 10% and lowers another by 10% (neutral ones change nothing). The role belongs to the species and changes nothing.

dev.title: Developer
dev.serverOffTitle: This server has developer tools off
dev.serverOffBody: The clock, finishing a session, items, weather and the fixed seed only change this browser, and the server ignores them. Run it with DEV_TOOLS=1 to use them. Only the local controls are left below.
dev.weatherNote: Only with DEV_TOOLS=1 on the server.

team.title: Your team studies with you
team.body: While you study, each Pokémon acts on its own and earns points, EXP and catch energy. The bar is its Energy for the day; it refills at 5:00.

start.title: Start with 25 minutes
start.body: Every 25-minute block brings a wave of wild Pokémon at the end. You can pause, but the team is locked until you finish.

conditions.title: Type conditions
conditions.body: Each type does better in certain situations: the time, the weather or the length. They only add, never subtract. Build your team around how and when you study.

weather.title: Weather where you study
weather.body: The real weather of your location or city (Settings) is used. Rain boosts Water types, sun boosts Fire and cold boosts Ice.

league.title: This week's league
league.body: Your team's points move you up, and a higher league brings bigger waves. Every Monday everyone goes back to Base League.

energy.title: Energy
energy.body: Every action costs Energy, so fast Pokémon tire sooner. An exhausted Pokémon stops acting but still earns EXP. In the Box they recover 10% per hour.

duration.title: Duration
duration.body: Pick 25, 50, 75 or 100 min, or any length from 15 to 120. Every full 25 minutes adds a wave, and long sessions attract rarer Pokémon.

break.title: Resting counts too
break.body: A complete break gives Energy back to your whole team. If you cut it short, it doesn't count.

checklist.title: Getting started
checklist.body: Seven steps to learn PokeFocus. Close it whenever you like; you can bring it back in Settings.

window.title: Claim in time
window.body: You have 5 minutes to claim 100%. If you're late you get half, so leaving the timer running on its own doesn't pay off.

why.title: Where your points come from
why.body: Each action gives points from the Pokémon's Output, multiplied by its type condition, its Bond and your Focus. Hover each tag for the details.

levelUp.title: Level up!
levelUp.body: Leveling up improves its stats and can teach it techniques. At levels 15, 30 and 50 it gains a technique slot.

hp.title: HP after the damage
hp.body: Your team weakens these Pokémon with the damage it dealt while you studied. Less HP means an easier catch. It never drops below 5%.

studyBall.title: Study Ball
studyBall.body: Each wave brings one that always catches a base-form Pokémon at level {{level}} or lower (the limit rises with your trainer level). It only works in this wave: move on without using it and it's lost.

throw.title: Throw a Ball
throw.body: Pick a wild Pokémon and a Ball; you'll see the chance before throwing. If it fails, the Pokémon counterattacks your leader and drains its Energy.

flee.title: Tries before it flees
flee.body: These squares are the misses it has left. When they run out, it flees. Legendaries that flee may come back in your next sessions.

counter.title: Counterattack
counter.body: {{name}} lost {{damage}} Energy. Failed Balls are paid by the leader (if exhausted, the next one). Each attack, instead, is paid by the attacker.

fled.title: It got away
fled.body: It used all its tries. That's fine: every session brings new waves. Lower HP or putting it to sleep helps next time.

firstCatch.title: Your first catch!
firstCatch.body: It's in your Box now. Between sessions you can add it to your team: up to 6 Pokémon study with you.

charges.title: Technique charges
charges.body: Your team's techniques left effects to use here. Putting a Pokémon to sleep or paralyzing it makes the catch easier; swapping replaces it with another.

shiny.title: Shiny
shiny.body: Shiny Pokémon are very rare. With the right Ball, or a better one, the catch is guaranteed.

next.title: Next wave
next.body: Wild Pokémon you don't catch stay behind. Each wave brings its own Study Ball.

iv.title: You can see quality
iv.body: A technique in your team reveals the quality (IVs) of wild Pokémon. Go for the ones with more stars.

damage.title: Attack the wild Pokémon
damage.body: Each token is the damage one of your Pokémon dealt in this block. Tap one, then a wild Pokémon: it attacks with everything and the wild one strikes back. It is final. Put it to sleep or paralyze it first and it cannot answer. In a hurry? Press Auto.

teamEnergy.title: Every attack gets an answer
teamEnergy.body: When one of your Pokémon attacks a wild Pokémon, the wild one strikes back at it. Here you see the whole team's Energy. Tip: put the wild Pokémon to sleep or paralyze it first and it can't answer.

intro.title: Your Box
intro.body: Every Pokémon you catch lives here. Tap one to open its page: techniques, candies, evolution and whether it joins the team.

filters.title: Filter and sort
filters.body: Search by name, filter by type or role, and sort by level or quality (IVs) to find your best candidate.

candies.title: Candies and Dust
candies.body: Candies give EXP to a Pokémon of their line (or type). Each one costs Study Dust, which you only earn by studying: studying stays in charge.

techniques.title: Technique slots
techniques.body: It has 1 to 4 slots depending on its level. Equip a damage technique to weaken wild Pokémon, or a passive or activable one to boost the session.

candies.title: Level it up with candies
candies.body: Each candy gives EXP right away and costs Dust. They go a long way at low levels, great for catching up a new Pokémon.

actions.title: Team, leader or release
actions.body: From here you add it to the team or make it the leader. Releasing duplicates gives you candies of their line.

mastery.title: Mastery
mastery.body: Each technique earns stars with the hours it spends equipped in sessions: 5 h, 15 h, 40 h and 100 h. More stars, higher chance to trigger. Remove it and it keeps its Mastery.

extraMoves.title: Extra techniques
extraMoves.body: Each individual has 2 or 3 random extra techniques. The strongest unlock at a higher level; until then they wait here.

iv.title: Quality (IVs)
iv.body: Each individual is born with values from 0 to 31 for each stat (its IVs). Higher IVs mean better stats, especially at high levels. No two Bulbasaur are the same.

stats.title: PokeFocus stats
stats.body: Each stat does something in your session: Pace is how often it acts, Output how many points it gives, Catch how much it weakens wild Pokémon. Hover each name to see it.

levelCap.title: Level cap
levelCap.body: Your Pokémon can't go past the current cap. Catch different species to raise it: 25 species open Lv 40 and 45 open Lv 50. Extra EXP isn't lost.

evolve.title: It can evolve!
evolve.body: Evolving improves its stats and keeps its level, techniques and Mastery. Press Evolve whenever you're ready.

energy.title: Daily Energy
energy.body: It's spent by acting and refills at 05:00. In the Box it recovers 10% per hour; in the team, only with breaks, techniques or potions.

bond.title: Bond
bond.body: Grows with every minute it studies in your team, up to +20% points. Some species evolve with high Bond.

intro.title: Build your team
intro.body: Order your 6 with the arrows or add them from the Box. Mix roles: someone for points, someone for catching and someone who can take hits.

leader.title: Pick the leader well
leader.body: It takes the counterattacks when a Ball fails. A leader with lots of Grit and Energy holds up better; check its type weaknesses too.

order.title: Order matters
order.body: The first one is the leader: it pays for failed Balls. If it's exhausted, they go to the next. Also, each Pokémon takes the counterattack of the wild Pokémon it attacks, so everyone's Grit counts.

tired.title: Someone is tired
tired.body: An exhausted or sleeping Pokémon doesn't act in the session. Move it to the Box to recover Energy and add someone else.

intro.title: Your Pokédex
intro.body: It records the 56 species of the pack. Those you see in a wave stay as a silhouette; those you catch, in color.

cap.title: More species, higher levels
cap.body: Every different species you catch brings your whole team closer to the next level cap.

intro.title: This week's league
intro.body: Your team's points raise your league, and each league lets more wild Pokémon appear per wave. Every Monday everyone goes back to Base.

stats.title: Your stats
stats.body: Hover each bar or point for details. The history below has every number.

focus.title: Focus
focus.body: It is your session's base performance: 100% if you claim within 5 minutes of the end, and 50% if you are late. It multiplies points, EXP and Dust, and each Pokémon's Grit adds up to 10% to its own points and EXP.

leaderboards.title: Leaderboards
leaderboards.body: Compare your points this week or month with everyone, with your country or just your friends. Your row is highlighted.

why.title: A real break
why.body: While it runs, step away from the screen. When it ends, collect the Energy for your team.

audio.title: Your sound
audio.body: Set music and effects separately. You can keep music only during sessions, or mute it altogether.

account.title: Your account
account.body: Change your name or country and your password, and sign out on devices you no longer use.

intro.title: Missions
intro.body: There are 3 daily and 3 weekly missions that renew by themselves, plus milestones for registering species. They advance as you study and catch; claim them here.

ready.title: Mission complete!
ready.body: You have rewards waiting. Open Missions to claim them.

pokedex.title: Pokédex milestones
pokedex.body: They complete once, when you catch 10, 25 and 50 different species. They give evolution stones and other items.

code.title: Your friend code
code.body: Share it with your study buddies. They use it to send you a request and, once you accept, they show up on your friends leaderboard.

add.title: Add by code
add.body: Ask your friend for their 8-character code and type it here. If they already sent you a request, you're connected right away.

request.title: You have a request
request.body: Someone wants to be your friend. Open Friends to accept or decline.

kindHelp.damage: Damage: on every action it generates catch energy of the technique's type. That energy weakens wild Pokémon so they are easier to catch.
kindHelp.passive: Passive: always on while it is equipped. It does not depend on luck: its effect (points, EXP, defense…) applies for the whole session.
kindHelp.activable: Activable: on every action it has a chance to trigger and give its effect (for example, put a wild Pokémon to sleep). Some have a limit per session or per week.

iv.title: Quality (IVs)
iv.what: IVs are values from 0 to 31, one per stat, that every Pokémon is born with. Here you see the number, its quality and how much it adds to that stat today.
iv.fixed: They are fixed for life: they do not change with level, evolution or nature. The stats are what change.
iv.effect: A high IV adds a little to that one stat at every level, and it shows more the higher the level.

damage.pickWild: Now tap the wild Pokémon {{name}} will attack. It's final.

toggle.on: Your team attacks on its own when you throw each wave's first Ball.
toggle.off: You choose which wild Pokémon each of yours attacks.

damage.noCounterAsleep: The wild Pokémon was asleep: it couldn't strike back.
damage.noCounterParalyzed: Paralysis kept it from striking back.

mic.onNote: Analysed in your browser every 2 s. Audio never leaves your device: only the percentages are sent.

status.insecure: The microphone needs HTTPS (or localhost). The session continues without a sound profile.
status.unsupported: No microphone is available in this browser or device. The session continues without a sound profile.
status.denied: Microphone permission denied. The session continues without a sound profile.
status.error: The microphone could not be used. The session continues without a sound profile.

mic.paused: Paused: the microphone is not listening

stopped.error: Microphone stopped: could not be used

mic.stoppedNote: What was analysed is kept. If it works again, it keeps counting.
mic.uncalibrated: This microphone is not calibrated: it learns its noise from the first quiet moments. Calibrate it in Settings for better results.
mic.private: Audio is analysed in your browser and never leaves your device.
mic.resultPartial: The microphone stopped ({{why}}): what was analysed counts, {{time}}.
mic.speakerNote: Only what the microphone hears counts: music through the speakers (the app's focus music too) counts as music; headphone music is not heard.
mic.speakerShort: Music only counts when it plays through the speakers.

cal.title: Calibrate the microphone
cal.intro: About 15 s for the microphone to learn its own noise, your voice and your music. At least the silence is needed. Audio never leaves your device.
cal.silenceNote: Measures the noise of your microphone and your room. Don't talk or type.
cal.voiceAskNote: You'll talk for 5 s in your normal voice. It helps recognise voices.
cal.voiceNote: Read something aloud or count to twenty.
cal.musicAsk: Do you study with music through the speakers? (optional)
cal.musicAskNote: Play it for 5 s at your usual volume and don't talk. If you use headphones, skip it: the microphone can't hear them.
cal.musicPlay: Play music through the speakers (5 s)
cal.music: Let your music play for 5 s
cal.noDevice: The microphone could not be identified. Try again.
cal.summary: Tuned to: {{parts}}. Everything else uses the standard values.
cal.checkSilence: Stay silent: it should say Silence
cal.checkMusic: Play your music: it should say Music
cal.checkHelp: Each reading takes about 2 s. If it gets it wrong, repeat the calibration in a quiet moment.
cal.never: Not calibrated. It is asked for when you turn the microphone on (about 15 s).
cal.outdated: Old calibration, without your microphone's noise: calibrate again.

notes.noSilence: No sound came from the microphone. Check it and try again.
notes.voiceTooQuiet: Your voice was barely heard: the standard values are used for voice.
notes.musicTooQuiet: The music was barely heard: the standard values are used for music.
notes.noisyRoom: Your room is a bit noisy: that background noise will count as silence.
notes.unsteadySilence: There was some noise during the silence. If the meter gets it wrong, repeat the calibration.

location.on: Using your approximate location (an area of about 10 km). It takes priority over the city.
location.cleared: Location removed. Your city is used, if you set one.

error.insecure: Location needs HTTPS (or localhost). Type your city in Settings.
error.unsupported: This browser does not provide a location. Type your city in Settings.
error.denied: Location permission denied. You can type your city in Settings.
error.unavailable: Your location could not be found right now.
error.timeout: The location took too long. Try again.
